intro: Drilha Rob is a company specialising in ship maintenance and repair and in industrial welding of iron, aluminium and stainless steel, as well as logistics and the fabrication of custom-made parts for the oil and gas sector.
We have a fully qualified team of professionals to respond efficiently and effectively to any type of work required by our clients and partners.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To deliver high-quality industrial and naval solutions in the oil and gas sector, focused on ship maintenance and repair and specialised welding, providing safety, efficiency and trust to our clients.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To be a national and international reference in industrial and naval services in the oil and gas sector, recognised for technical excellence, continuous innovation and a commitment to the highest standards of quality and safety.

items.title: Commitment
items.text: We act with responsibility and dedication in every project.

items.title: Technical excellence
items.text: We always pursue the highest standards of quality and innovation.

items.title: Safety
items.text: We put the safety of our employees, clients and operations first.

items.title: Integrity
items.text: We operate with ethics, transparency and respect in all relationships.

items.title: Sustainability
items.text: We promote practices that respect the environment and contribute to sustainable development.
